How To Play

  • Drag cards to reorder your hand.
  • Click a card to select it.
  • Select 2+ cards and hit Group Selected to bundle a meld.
  • On your turn, draw from the Stock or Discard pile.
  • Select 1 card and hit Discard Selected to end your turn.
  • Every group must be a valid Set or Sequence — at least 2 sequences are required, and at least 1 must be Pure (no jokers).
  • 🃏 Printed Jokers and cards matching the Wild Joker rank can substitute any card in a Set or an Impure Sequence.
  • 3 computer players draw, discard, and declare automatically — watch the "Thinking…" badge for their turn.
